history.title: Fatih Camii - From Past to Present
history.content1: IGMG Fatih Camii was first established in 1976 on Formerstraße. As our community grew and our needs developed, we moved from our first location to Garbenheimerstraße. There we had the opportunity to create a larger mosque and community center.
history.content2: However, as our continuously growing community needed more space, we decided to move to Niedergirmeser Weg. Here we found a larger and more suitable place for our community.
history.content3: In 2019, the last and largest move of our mosque took place. Our spacious grounds on Philipsstraße became the ideal place to meet the needs of our growing community.
history.content4: From past to present, the story of our mosque is one of continuous growth and striving to better serve our community. As today, we will continue to serve our community tomorrow. We thank you for being with us on this journey.

community.title: Prayer, Community, Unity
community.content1: The story of IGMG Fatih Camii began in the basement of a house. When we were founded in 1976, some residents complained about the noise. But we didn't give up. With faith and determination, we continued this journey that we started with our small community.
community.content2: Over time, our small congregation began to grow and finally, after years of effort, we found the opportunity to acquire our own property.
community.content3: The story of IGMG Fatih Camii is a story of faith, belief, perseverance and community spirit. And this story will continue tomorrow, just as it does today. Thank you for walking this path with us.

thankYou.title: Gratitude and Recognition
thankYou.content: We would like to express our deep gratitude to all former and current chairpersons. Through their leadership, commitment and dedication, they have shaped our community and made it what it is today. Their tireless work and dedication to the welfare of the community will remain in our hearts forever.
